subject: Back-to-back co‑host + SI deep-dive: scheduling options and runbook
messages:

Subject: Demo request — back-to-back cohost + SI deep-dive

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Orbit would like to schedule a pair of sessions next week: a 30–40m product overview co‑hosted by Redwood and CloudForge, immediately followed by a 45–60m SI deep‑dive with CloudForge (APAC team). Goal is to move our internal approval forward for a pilot.

Constraints: our stakeholder block is Wed 18th 10:00–12:30 PST (they prefer a morning slot). Because our engineering obs are APAC, we need the SI deep‑dive to start no earlier than 12:30 PST (so engineers are online).

Can Redwood and CloudForge do back‑to‑back on Wed 18th where overview is 10:00–10:40 PT and the SI session starts at 10:55 PT? We want a 15m buffer for handoff and quick notes. If that exact cadence is rough, please propose alternatives.

Also, happy to share a short agenda and any pre‑reads.

Thanks — Kai
Kai Huang
Head of Product, Orbit Systems
kai@orbit-systems.com

Initial proposal:
- Overview (co‑host): Wed 18 Nov, 10:00–10:35 PT — Redwood product lead + CloudForge AE
- Buffer/QA transition: 10:35–10:50 PT (15m)
- SI deep‑dive: 10:50–11:40 PT — CloudForge solutions engineer + Orbit engineers

We attached a draft agenda and a short SI ops runbook for the handoff (see attachments). Two asks:
1) Kai/Jenna — confirm the timezone of your engineers (PST vs UTC+?); APAC overlap varies.
2) Karthik — can CloudForge provide a named SE and confirm they can do the 10:50–11:40 PT window?

If the stakeholder requires 10:00–10:40 strictly and engineers are only available after 12:30 PT, we can propose a staggered split (overview on Wed, SI deep‑dive on Thu afternoon) but prefer back‑to‑back to keep momentum.

Calendly link for backup slots: https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/45min-demo

Best,
